title: Speaking from the Heart (Part 2)
style: groovy bossa nova deephouse r&b chillwave. breathy vocals, clear enunciation.
lyrics:
[verse]
Hear the beat feel the start
Words pourin' straight from the heart
No need to play a part
Truth in the light where we dart

[verse]
Flowin' like the breeze at night
Shine ya soul so bright
No games no fight
Pure truth pure delight

[chorus]
Speak it from the heart
That's where the magic starts
No need to tear apart
Just love and be smart

[verse]
Groove in the vibe we tread
Light as a feather no dread
Words we mean we said
Honesty colors us red

[verse]
Under the moon and stars
Simple honest hearts
No walls no scars
Thriving like coral bars

[bridge]
Feel it in the rhythm babe
True words cascade
No charades no shade
Just pure love displayed
